quarterly_data.signal: 2026 Q3 report (unaudited): Q3 revenue RMB 5,855,689,454.32, up 45.46% year over year; Jan-Sep revenue RMB 14,954,710,229.13, up 57.58%. Net profit attributable to shareholders: Q3 RMB 1,048,040,894.63 (+37.90%), Jan-Sep RMB 2,846,508,812.66 (+45.12%); excluding share-based payment, Jan-Sep net profit attributable RMB 3,585,934,858.98 (+76.90%). R&D investment: Q3 RMB 1,819,662,147.21 (+48.68%, 31.08% of revenue), Jan-Sep RMB 4,472,044,952.74 (+52.39%, 29.90% of revenue). The company attributes the growth to rising domestic demand for high-end chips as AI develops rapidly and localization shifts from policy-driven to market-driven, and to continued iteration of its products for the general-purpose and AI computing markets, where it says it keeps a competitive advantage and market lead.
